title: WebGL shader addresses a screen-sized texture by gl_FragCoord, assuming a bottom-left origin, on a top-left-origin backend
expected_finding: fsMain computes uv = FragCoord.xy / screenSize, treating FragCoord.y as measured from the bottom (WebGL), but Vulkan's FragCoord origin is the upper left; screen_texture is stored with row 0 at the bottom of the screen, so the lookup is vertically mirrored (top shows blue, bottom red)
